description: Signed whole calendar days from the from date to the to date, midnight to midnight in tz: positive when to is later, negative when it is earlier. Endpoints are exclusive, so this is the gap and consecutive dates are 1 apart. Either date may be "today", resolved in tz. For working days between two dates use business_days; to move a date by N days use add_days or subtract_days.

from.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

to.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or "today" (resolved in tz)

tz.description: IANA timezone that defines "today" (e.g. Africa/Kampala). Default UTC.

name: days_between

receipt.description: Auditable receipt: inputs, timezone, convention, workweek, holiday calendar, exclusions, versions, stable result ID

title: Days between two dates
